feature-planning.description: Plan, revise, complete, or report status using the shared Dockering feature-planning skill.
feature-planning.template: Load the feature-planning skill and follow it for this request: $ARGUMENTS. Use OpenCode's question tool when the skill calls for AskUserQuestion.

release.description: Cut a release, report release status, or guide the Windows signing setup using the shared Dockering release skill.
release.template: Load the release skill and follow it for this request: $ARGUMENTS. Use OpenCode's question tool when the skill calls for AskUserQuestion.

architect.description: Design Dockering features, plans, ADRs, and cross-crate architecture; edits only spec and plan docs.

rust-core.description: Implement engine-agnostic Rust in dk-core and dk-hub: DTOs, Engine contract, runtime, streams, and persistence.

engine-integrator.description: Implement Docker and WSLC engine operations, protocol mapping, tolerant parsers, and backend contract coverage.

windows-platform.description: Implement Windows integrations: WSL discovery, WSLC COM, named pipes, ConPTY, Win32 APIs, and platform quirks.

gpui-ui.description: Build GPUI Kit UI, stores, keyboard actions, and terminal views in dockering and dk-terminal.

qa-engineer.description: Verify requirement coverage with unit, fixture, contract, hub, and GPUI tests; maintain the release checklist.

reviewer.description: Review spec conformance, architecture, threading, capability gating, security, portability, and test coverage; return findings.

release-engineer.description: Maintain Cargo build configuration, dependencies, CI, bootstrap scripts, licensing, packaging, signing, and releases.
